evidence: Vynamic SmartVision uses AI to reduce friction and minimize shrink losses by detecting loss sources at checkouts, recognizing products including fresh produce, verifying consumer age for certain restricted purchases, spotting suspicious behaviors and identifying safety hazards

We are capitalizing on the need to solve the most common sources of loss / friction at self-service and traditional assisted checkouts through our AI-enabled software, which is designed to prevent shrink, age-restricted sales, product identification, etc.
Developing artificial intelligence (AI) skills is also a key component to driving efficiency and innovation across the organization
We are also integrating AI into the Company's operations. We maintain guidelines and policies that govern our use of AI.
ai_positioning.summary: DBD intègre l'IA dans ses produits de vente au détail (Vynamic SmartVision) et ses opérations internes, tout en développant les compétences IA de son organisation. La société utilise l'IA pour réduire les pertes et améliorer l'expérience client, mais reste prudente quant aux risques associés.
